text: （1）Non-Chinese citizens who are in good physical and mental health, have a strong academic background, consciously abide by Chinese laws and school regulations, and respect the customs and habits of the Chinese people. (2) Master's Degree: Must hold a bachelor's degree or equivalent qualification, and the age should generally not exceed 30 years old. Doctor: Must hold a master's degree or equivalent qualifications, and generally not exceed 40 years of age.
